title: Seven government attempts to seize the bodies at the University of Ica

tellings.quote: On seven occasions they came with first with police, with a prosecutor and all that.

plain: A man named Martin Alacrone says that in the 2020s the Peruvian authorities came seven times to the University of Ica to take away the strange three-fingered bodies kept there, at first bringing police and a prosecutor. Alacrone tells Michels this as someone who was there. If true, it would mean the government was pressing hard to take control of the bodies.
